workflow.title: Separate Mac settings changes from storage cleanup
workflow.primaryIntent: A MacPilot user deciding whether a symptom calls for a configuration change, targeted maintenance, or storage investigation.
workflow.description: Start with the symptom, not a maintenance checklist. MacPilot documents settings controls and targeted maintenance; storage growth needs evidence about what is growing before deletion.
outline: Classify the symptom: preference behavior, stale preview/association, or disk growth
Record the OS and the original setting before a supported change; Save Points are settings, not file backups
Distinguish QuickLook cache/Launch Services maintenance from finding large or recurring data
Inspect before approving cleanup; large files are not automatically disposable
Choose MacPilot for customization; consider Breathing Room, which we build, for source-documented storage/activity workflows with preview and hosted-AI limits
workflow.visualPlan: MacPilot official Maintenance image after lead only after written permission and actual inspection; Breathing Room Space example preview later with exact caption.
workflow.interactionPass: Hand off a non-mutating symptom checklist with three routes: setting behavior -> configuration documentation; specific cache/association problem -> targeted documented maintenance; storage growth -> inspect owners/history. No automatic deletion suggestions, generated savings, forced runnable demo or account arc.
workflow.prohibited: No tested walkthrough, command snippets, OS-target claims, performance promises, system-protection changes or duplicate general alternatives article.

comparison.title: Breathing Room vs MacPilot: storage investigation or system tweaks?
comparison.primaryIntent: Choose between adjacent Mac utilities for a specific job, not a universal winner.
comparison.lead: MacPilot is the documented choice here for macOS settings controls and configuration Save Points. Breathing Room, which we build, focuses on storage/activity investigation in a qualified preview; it is not established as a substitute for MacPilot customization.
structure: Concise claim-linked matrix with unknown cells, not negative checkmarks
When MacPilot fits; when Breathing Room may fit; built-in tools may suffice for a narrow need
Pricing scope, preview/runtime, privileges and hosted-data caveats
comparison.pricingPolicy: Quote only advertised Solo offers with unresolved currency/annual charge caveat, or omit subscription amount and link current offer. No cheaper verdict or rounded annual total.

macpilotAdvantages: Documented breadth of Finder/Dock/system settings and configuration Save Points (C04-C05).
Targeted maintenance and advanced disk/file information in the official feature list (C04).
Current-version-only and lifetime-update purchase options are advertised, alongside subscription (C07).
macpilotTradeoffs: Advanced settings can require admin rights or be limited by system protections; do not encourage bypasses (C09).
Reset-to-default/Save Points are not established deleted-file recovery (C05).
Detailed storage-growth/helper/developer-cache workflows remain unknown, not absent (C11).
breathingRoomAdvantages: Source-documented storage ownership views, grouped activity and developer-cache discovery provide a different investigation workflow (B02/S5).
Free local core is distinct from optional paid hosted reasoning (B03).
breathingRoomTradeoffs: Preview, Python prerequisite, signing/notarization and incomplete platform QA constrain installation recommendations (B01).
Hosted AI needs authentication/network and can transmit contextual data; daily care requires running app and saved approvals (B02-B03).
Not established as a replacement for MacPilot customization; no measured speed, safety or savings comparison.
